name: rooftop-opening
description: Two/three-panel opening mapped onto audios/kraft.mp3 after running scripts/analyze_reel_audio.py. Storyboard intent preserved (wide establishing → match-cut → CU → dissolve), but panel boundaries land on actual audio energy gaps: the 1.2s silence before the intro beat, the 6.0s chorus lift, and the 12.6s climax hit. Source: user-provided storyboard, 2026-09-09.

transitionOut.name: match-cut
transitionOut.audioCue: 0.8–1.2s silence gap before the intro beat lands at 1.2s
transitionOut.note: Storyboard's 'head turn match cut' — audio silence is the natural cut. Palette swap (wide → CU) is the transition.

storyboard.label: EXT. CITY ROOFTOP — NIGHT
storyboard.shot: WIDE — Artist standing alone on rooftop, city lights, rim light from full moon above
storyboard.music: Intro silence — first hit at 0.2s, release into 1.2s of quiet
storyboard.color: Deep blues, purple, warm orange from city, moonlight silver/white

transitionOut.name: dissolve
transitionOut.audioCue: 6.0s — sustained section ends, chorus lifts at 6.8s. Storyboard's 'vocal line completion' = first big chorus hit.
transitionOut.note: Paint-stroke reads as the atmospheric/poetic version of a slow dissolve.

storyboard.label: CLOSE UP — Artist's face turning
storyboard.shot: CU — Face turning, carried by the build-up (2.75–3.80)
storyboard.color: Warm rim from one side, cool blue rim from the other
storyboard.intent: Establish intimacy and intensity. Eye contact draws viewer in.

transitionIn.name: warp-dissolve
transitionIn.audioCue: Chorus hits at 6.8s. Storyboard says 'camera pulls back through window reflection reveal' — warp-dissolve bends + blurs, suggests a pull-back reveal.
transitionIn.note: Not in the original storyboard — added by the audio study. The chorus needs its own cut.

transitionOut.name: lens-flare
transitionOut.audioCue: 12.6s — peak RMS (0.146) at 12.8s. Climactic hit. Lens-flare blooms on the energy peak.
transitionOut.note: A music-video workhorse transition — works here because the climax hit is the natural punctuation.

storyboard.label: WIDE — pull-back reveal
storyboard.shot: WIDE — camera pulls back through window reflection, the city is back
storyboard.color: Deep blues + city lights again — the mood opens back up
storyboard.intent: Reset to scale. The artist's intimacy gives way to the full rooftop scene, lit by the climax hit.
